name: HOSON
summary: HOSON is the brand of Shenzhen Xinyichang Technology, a Shenzhen manufacturer of high-precision semiconductor equipment. The company develops embodied robots through its wholly owned Shenzhen Xinyichang Robotics subsidiary, drawing on its motion-control and equipment engineering work. Its HOSON-Robot platform targets material handling and assembly tasks in semiconductor and electronics production.
